Three.js r170 — MIT license. https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r170/LICENSE
Earth and cloud texture assets: https://threejs.org/examples/textures/planets/earth_atmos_2048.jpg and https://threejs.org/examples/textures/planets/earth_clouds_1024.png (Three.js example planetary textures).
Audience and runway images created with image generation for this project.

Geographic imagery exported using the public ArcGIS World Imagery MapServer export endpoint, EPSG:3857. Four explicitly bounded 1024px views for this animation. Credit: Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics and the GIS User Community. Attribution is displayed during the map sequence. Paris target: 2.336 E, 48.863 N; runway is fictional.
Optional audio is chosen locally by the visitor. No YouTube API or video is loaded.

Original soundtrack: Le Défilé, 120 BPM, 24 seconds. All instruments synthesized from sine/saw oscillators and seeded noise in scripts/compose_soundtrack.py. No third-party music recordings, samples, or melodies used. MP3 master normalised to -15 LUFS target.
